[Intro: bright horn riff, clean guitar chops, rolling bass]

[Verse 1: smooth tenor, light and happy]

We didn't have a single place to go

[Pre-Chorus: falsetto joins, horns climb]

[Chorus: group vocals, falsetto on top, horns answering]

Now the calendar has turned a few more pages

I am twenty-one and I'm not getting old
